items.title: 'AI trade never died': Traders see room for market recovery, but bitcoin's participation is another story
items.summary: Monday's tech enthusiasm is quickly fading on Tuesday, while bitcoin remains near bear-market lows.

items.title: Anchorage Digital to unveil new asset-management subsidiary
items.summary: The crypto custody technology firm said it will unveil a separate subsidiary called 61st Parallel Asset Management.

items.title: South Korea proposes ending 2017 ICO ban to boost jobs and onshore crypto investment
items.summary: Token issuers would have to disclose how they plan to spend investors' money and could face criminal charges for misleading buyers.

items.title: Crypto trader Ansem says his wallet was hacked as $2 million in memecoins were sold
items.summary: Ansem suspects someone broke into his account on Bullpen, the trading terminal he co-founded, where the wallet's private key had been imported.

items.title: Live updates: Bitcoin pulls back below $60,000, stock rally fades, as tariffs re-enter the picture
items.summary: The Trump Administration could unveil tariff hikes against China, Japan, South Korea and other countries as soon as this week, according to a WSJ report.

items.title: Bitcoin drops as November spot ETF outflows increase to record $4.71 billion
items.summary: Your day-ahead look for Nov. 24, 2026

items.title: JPMorgan, HSBC and StoneX complete first digital gold trades in London
items.summary: The banks tested a new way to trade fractions of physical gold bars and use the metal as collateral without moving it from vaults for the first time.

items.title: Bitcoin hands back Monday's Nvidia-driven gains, liquidations triple
items.summary: Bitcoin (BTC) has dropped 2.2% since midnight UTC to around $59,900, giving back Monday's jump and lagging the stock market's rebound from last week's selloff.

items.title: Bitcoin’s drop to $55,000 left a record 11.6 million BTC underwater
items.summary: Bitcoin’s supply in profit fell below its 2022 FTX collapse low, while entities holding 100 to 10,000 BTC continued to accumulate.

items.title: U.S. seeks $1.1 billion seized in Binance hack as North Korean funds keep moving
items.summary: U.S. seeks to recover $1.1 billion in frozen USDC as billions more from the Binance hack remain unaccounted for.

items.title: Bitcoin slides amid US tariff nerves as Anthropic falls below IPO price
items.summary: Bitcoin gave up gains above $60,000 as tariff concerns weighed on US stocks and Anthropic shares hit new lows below $76.

items.title: How South Korea’s proposed 20% cap could change who runs Upbit
items.summary: Naver Financial agreed to buy every share in Upbit’s operator, but a proposed ownership cap could strip away its voting rights on four-fifths of them.

items.title: USDT buyers face 22% VAT when Moscow Exchange opens crypto trading
items.summary: Buyers will pay VAT on top of the trade price in December because Russia’s tax code has no explicit exemption for foreign digital instruments.

items.title: Swiss central bank, UBS and SIX study ledger for tokenized settlement
items.summary: The study will assess whether a shared ledger can bring central bank money, commercial bank money and securities onto the same platform.

items.title: Sky lender proposes buyback of up to $50M to fund stUSDS withdrawals
items.summary: Borrowers would sell SKY to the protocol and use the proceeds to pay down their loans, freeing up funds for depositors in the stUSDS pool.

items.title: Grayscale calls Bitcoin ‘oversold’ at $62K but warns of AI risks
items.summary: Grayscale said Bitcoin’s bear market was its longest on record at 411 days and counting, though the 56% drop was the smallest percentage decline.

items.title: South Korea proposes bank-led stablecoins, 20% cap on crypto exchange stakes
items.summary: The draft bill would also reopen domestic initial coin offerings after a ban dating to 2017 and require issuers to disclose risks before soliciting buyers.

items.title: Bitcoin dipped on Huang’s Nvidia exit but jumped 5% on his return
items.summary: Bitcoin rose about 5% on Jensen Huang’s return, more than the 3.5% it lost on news of his exit, but remained 19.2% below its pre-resignation price.

items.title: Bitcoin dips back under $60K as gold seals worst 60-day loss since 1980s
items.summary: Bitcoin continued to threaten the loss of $60,000 support as gold attempted to bounce from a 60-day losing streak during which it fell nearly 25%.

items.title: Bitcoin ETFs keep bleeding as BlackRock’s IBIT shares gain nearly 5%
items.summary: BlackRock’s IBIT shares gained 4.85% on Monday despite continued Bitcoin ETF withdrawals that pushed November’s net outflows to $4.71 billion.

items.title: Europol Traces $28M in Crypto Behind Europe's Illegal Streaming Industry
items.summary: Police from 11 countries worked with Binance, Coinbase and Chainalysis to follow crypto payments made to pirate TV services.

items.title: Justice Department Moves to Forfeit $1.1B in USDC From North Korea's Binance Hack
items.summary: U.S. authorities say they've now helped freeze, seize or return more than $2.9 billion of the crypto stolen from Binance in October.

items.title: CertiK Trains Interpol Investigators to Trace and Freeze Stolen Crypto
items.summary: The blockchain security firm walked officers from across Asia and the South Pacific through a real wallet-theft case at a workshop in Hanoi.

items.title: Morning Minute: Jensen Returns, Markets Soar (Except Crypto)
items.summary: It was a very green Monday for most markets, but crypto couldn’t hold the pump as ETF sellers race for the exits.

items.title: GTA 6 PC Ports ‘Nuked’ Just Days Before Devs Expected It to Be Playable
items.summary: Leonida and GTA6Modding went dark a day after Cyberleek released the executable file that porters had been waiting for.

items.title: $14.7B in ‘Lost’ Bitcoin Has Moved Since 2018: Report
items.summary: Roughly 245,000 BTC has left almost 10,000 wallets presumed lost, undercutting a lawsuit that argues silence means abandonment.

items.title: Trump Says He 'Made the Deal' to Reinstate Jensen Huang, Sparking Bipartisan Backlash
items.summary: Lawmakers from both parties want to know what national security assurances the White House gave Nvidia's board before it brought Huang back.

items.title: China's Z.ai Says Its New AI Model Can Think Like One Four Times Its Size
items.summary: GLM-5.4 uses a looping architecture to squeeze more reasoning power from fewer parameters, challenging the expensive approach favored by American AI giants.

items.title: OpenAI Will Pay You Up to $8K to Preach the AI Gospel to Small Businesses
items.summary: OpenAI wants local AI evangelists to bring ChatGPT to Main Street. Its new OpenWorks program pays up to $8,000 monthly, provided you can actually help businesses get things done locally.

items.title: Why One Math Proof Has AI Experts Warning Humans Might Soon Lose Control
items.summary: Alexandr Wang says Claude’s role in a verified Riemann Hypothesis proof signals a turning point, warning that powerful self-improving AI systems could advance faster than people can supervise them.
